entities.name: WLAN offload indication
entities.description: Indicates if the UE is allowed to offload the traffic of the associated PDN connection to WLAN(s).

entities.name: PDN connection
entities.description: The PDN connection whose traffic may be offloaded to WLAN.

entities.name: WLAN offload allowed
entities.description: Condition indicating whether UE traffic offload to WLAN is permitted.

relations.description: The WLAN offload indication IE contains the condition for WLAN offload permission.
The WLAN offload allowed condition establishes whether PDN connection traffic can be offloaded to WLAN.
